title: Price overflow DoS from compound growth
description: Compound growth price + (price * growthBP / 10000) will overflow uint256 after finite mints. However, the price is already economically impossible long before overflow occurs. The overflow is a redundant failure mode.
impact: Theoretical DoS, but price is already too high to mint. Owner can reset with setPrice().
recommendation: Consider adding a price cap or documenting the mathematical limit.
